comparable_cases.name: Finder list and preview views
comparable_cases.user_context: Mac users inspecting large file collections
comparable_cases.task: Find a file, compare attributes, inspect a selection
comparable_cases.pattern: Stable navigation alongside a list with named sortable columns and selection-specific details
comparable_cases.interaction: Column headings sort; selection exposes details; different views support different browsing tasks
comparable_cases.states: Selected/unselected item and alternate view modes documented
comparable_cases.accessibility: Transfer native table selection and system focus; official support article does not independently establish VoiceOver quality
comparable_cases.success: Inference: familiar separation lets users orient and compare many rows without repeating explanatory text
comparable_cases.failure: Inference: a full filesystem tree or view-mode chooser would add scope Simplify does not need
comparable_cases.transferability: Use collection sidebar, sortable/resizable table and compact inspector; retain native keyboard selection

comparable_cases.name: XLN Audio XO sample folders
comparable_cases.user_context: Musicians with samples distributed across folders
comparable_cases.task: Include personal sample collections in an audio browser
comparable_cases.pattern: Add folders through picker or drop, then explicit Scan & Refresh; changed-folder indicator prompts rescan
comparable_cases.interaction: Sample Folders control opens roots; add folders then scan
comparable_cases.states: Configured roots, scan request, changed content requiring refresh
comparable_cases.accessibility: Borrow explicit text labels; a color-only change dot needs a text equivalent in Simplify
comparable_cases.success: Inference: folder setup directly produces useful content rather than teaching abstract settings
comparable_cases.failure: Inference: change detection is not implemented in Simplify and must not be implied by visual indicators
comparable_cases.transferability: Make source selection the central onboarding task; use local Splice folder as an example, not account integration

comparable_cases.name: DaisyDisk disk and folder scanning
comparable_cases.user_context: Mac users investigating storage on multiple volumes
comparable_cases.task: Choose a scope and begin inspection
comparable_cases.pattern: Visible scan targets with direct Scan actions; specific folder selection available
comparable_cases.interaction: Scan a volume or choose a folder before results are produced
comparable_cases.accessibility: Transfer labeled controls and state text; official guide does not establish accessibility performance
comparable_cases.success: Inference: clear scope gives users confidence about what a scan will include
comparable_cases.failure: Inference: a storage treemap would distract from Simplify's filename and project-evidence comparison task
comparable_cases.transferability: Show chosen folder categories and ready-to-scan summary; avoid claiming logical sizes equal reclaimable disk space

source_limitations: Reuses the documented native collection design research. No new comparable applications were run. Apple HIG live fetch returned a JavaScript shell. This increment changes state feedback and disabled removal availability within existing native components.

requirements: Saved inventory must be labeled as cached, with a refresh action.
Unobserved rows and instruments use visible words, not color alone.
Cached removal controls must be disabled with an explanation.
Saving failures preserve live browsing and provide visible feedback.
recurring_patterns: Stable collection navigation and selection details (Finder)
project_inferences: Retain the current table/sidebar/inspector system while the database foundation is completed.
Use the existing footer for saved/error states and existing format sheet for removal availability.
hypotheses: Immediate cached browsing reduces repeated scanning friction; 3000-sample restore target is under two seconds on the current Mac.

decision: Extend existing state feedback and removal controls for durable inventory; no new navigation or onboarding step.
validation: Native cached browse and removal-disabled assertions
Native reopen after generated fixture removal
Independent screenshot and UX review; report assistive-technology limits separately
